purpose: Account of launching AI Shipping Labs with Valeriia

required_facts.fact: Alexey and Valeriia launched AI Shipping Labs.
A live launch event was planned for April 13.
The community addresses unstructured, solitary AI learning.
Members receive Slack access and early personal onboarding.
Accountability circles run in sprints with check-ins.
Building sessions occur once or twice monthly for 1.5–2 hours.
Career support includes resume and personal branding feedback.
AI Shipping Labs is separate from free DataTalks.Club Zoomcamps.

author_attribution: Attribute the community launch and plans to Alexey and Valeriia; preserve that future features were still being built.
